panels.text: 03/08/2026 Following the migration of UAT to Azure some issues have been raised which are being worked through to resolution. Production migration is planned for the weekend of 15/16 August. The build of the production environment is progressing, with a target to complete 03/08. All infrastructure has been created and functions, APIs and UI have been deployed. Testing will commence 04/08. Discussions are ongoing with Elastic about consumption and spend. The Elastic PS is unlikely to reduce the spend to the forecast level for managed. Other alternatives being considered are Serverless Elastic and reverting to self hosting. SQL costs for July were higher than expected. Options to reduce spend are being investigated. RAG is Amber for the production migration in mid August.

Enterprise in Cloud is the current priority and will continue to receive primary resource allocation. Work on DC Exit will progress as capacity becomes available. Workshops and planning calls held to discuss scope and next steps, further planning to take place. A spreadsheet containing resources has been compiled with some quick wins identified. Started decommissioning/shutting down servers that are no longer required or suspected that they’re no longer in use. Had a meeting this morning to discuss VM migration location in Azure, such as V1 or V2 subscription, resources, V-Net and IP range.

New RGP prod servers built, SQL Server installed and added to the cluster [ Done ] Standalone SQL server provisioned and databases restored and ready for testing [ Done ] AG set up and database restores on new servers to be completed before end of the week. [ Currently ongoing ] Performance query optimisation. Meeting with engineering and assigned updates to the team for implementation [ Currently ongoing\ Done ] Reviewing Immutable SQL Server Backups on Azure Blob Storage doc [ Done ] DataIDX disk will kick off testing today [ Currently ongoing ] Log-shipping set up on ODENSQLPROD01.  Blocker:  unable to access server raising ticket with ServiceDesk Migrate CDS and CubeImport from On-prem test to SQL MI this week [ To Do ]    Consolidated 13 existing AlwaysOn Availability Groups into a single Availability Group on PREP and UAT. Configured backups for the UAT SQL Azure VMs using the existing on-premises file server as a temporary solution until Azure Blob Storage is available. Completed creation and configuration of all required SQL maintenance jobs in the UAT environment and reviewed SQL Agent permissions. Revisit unused indexes across DRP databases (DEV and Production) and begin the planned cleanup. Kick off data cleanup in DEV for the InsightProfileResult and CustomerInsightRel tables.    CustomerProfileConceptRel data cleanup on the customer database on RPG in Production completed. Completed TEST SQL MI configuration and successfully failed over to Azure. Reinstalled SQL Server 2025 on the new DRP database server but need clarification if these are still required if the architecture design as changed regarding SQL MI. Configured the UAT Azure SQL VM and all databases restored as standalone ready for testing. Ongoing tasks to build out new UAT SQL Azure VMs for go-live migration Kick off data cleanup in RGP DEV for the InsightProfileResult and CustomerInsightRel tables after script deletion review.     No progress on the RGP Test SQL Managed Instance configuration setup last week due to other priorities; work planned to resume this week. Database Watch now configured on AZURE to help with ongoing performance issues on UAT. But the DBAs are unable to view some of the dashboards due to permission issues. Raised this with Paul and waiting for response.  Successfully rolled out Query Store across all DRP production databases.  Configuration setup for the RGP Test SQL Managed Instance was meant to commence on Friday but was off sick. Will start looking at this this week Continue reviewing database access across DRP environments and progress remediation activities. Add missing databases to the PROD1 AlwaysOn Availability Group. Completed  Kick off DRP remediation activities, including planning for the migration of databases to the new server estate. Ongoing and next phase to start this week   ===    [DBOPS-169] Upgrade PROD2 Windows/SQL Servers to v2022   PROD2 Database migration to the new set of production servers, completed over the course of the weekend (02th of May 2026) [DBOPS-54] AG & Replication Monitoring Always On Alerting Implementation: Completed and running on all prod and UAT environments on the on-prem environment Outstanding:- Documenting setup [DBOPS-92] Query Optimisation - Production Ongoing works with the Engineering team to implement recommended changes. Most of the tasks have now been allocated to an engineer who is working closely with the DBA team [DBOPS-288] Enterprise Dev team access to Azure SQL MI UAT database Failover to Azure Assisting with troubleshooting on DEV SQL MI

03/08/26 All CUBE repos have been migrated to GHE and pipelines relinked to use GHE. Kodex migration has been completed. The majority of Acin repos have been migrated, 60 are outstanding, pipeline migration is to be completed. Discussion to be held with 4C regarding migration dates and access has been provided to 4C repos for review. The pipeline inventory has been shared with Engineering managers and calls are being held to review Pipelines which are in scope for migration and assess alignment with Golden Pipeline. A pilot version of the pipeline, including skills has been created and tested on pipelines. RAG is Amber due to status of the pipeline migration.

03/08/26 ProtonVPN has been onboarded. Ticket for Proton VPN subscription -        to action set up of Proton VPN. BrightData is used by 4CRisk and requires onboarding. This has the benefit of being whitelisted for a number of government websites, which makes monitoring of these IBs easier. Additional ProtonVPN proxies are being onboarded.

The remaining module will need to remain on the 4CRisk OpenAI platform for an additional month, as the team has identified that its equivalent module in AI Foundry has been deprecated. The functionality dependent on this module, Global Search, is business-critical. Team is working towards fully migrating the Global Search functionality by the end of August. [ Open ]
